name: AP_INVOICE_KEY_IND_ALL
description: AP_INVOICE_KEY_IND stores compiled invoice information for the Key Indicators Report.  There is one row for each period for which you report on invoice key indicators.  The information in this table is denormalized for reporting purposes. . This table has no foreign keys.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period name of the payables calendar.

columns.name: CALENDAR_NAME
columns.description: Name of the payables calendar used.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: NUM_INVOICES
columns.description: Number of invoices at the end of reporting period.

columns.name: AMOUNT_INVOICES
columns.description: Amount on the invoices at the end of reporting period.

columns.name: NUM_DISTRIBUTION_LINES
columns.description: Number of invoice distributions lines at end of reporting period.

columns.name: NUM_BATCHES

columns.name: NUM_INVOICE_VARIANCES
columns.description: Number of invoices where, at end of reporting period, invoice amount does not match invoice distribution

columns.name: AMOUNT_INVOICE_VARIANCES
columns.description: Amount of invoices where, at end of reporting period, invoice amount does not match invoice distribution

columns.name: NUM_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
